    Questions? Quick answers.

    What happens when my days or km run out?

    Your plan ends at whichever runs out first. Renew in the app in one tap, or top up km.

    I rent my EV from a fleet partner. How do I get a plan?

    [Confirm flow.] Some partners include swaps in your rent. If yours doesn't, pick a plan in the EnergyApp app and add your vehicle number.

    Does swapping work for my auto or loader?

    Yes, for autos, e-rickshaws and e-loaders. [List compatible models.]

    What if a station has no charged battery?

    The app shows live stock, so you can see which stations have batteries before you go.

    Is there a swap station in my town?

    Check the station map. If not, you can rent a battery and charge it at home. See “Rent a battery” above.

    Can I pause my plan?

    [Confirm pause policy.]
